title: D3.js
summary: Data diagrams drawn as comic panels: an angled card with a pale gutter and hard shadow over a sunset backdrop, inked shapes with gradient fills, and titles in outlined lettering. Use them full-screen as cutaways, or pass "clear": true to float the card over footage.

items.name: Bar chart
items.description: Chunky inked bars with gradient fills and hard shadows; values pop on top.

items.name: Line chart
items.description: A fat inked trend line over a gradient fill, the last value on a burst.

items.name: Donut
items.description: Shares of a whole as fat ring segments sweeping round, the largest called out in the middle.

items.name: Ranking
items.description: Horizontal bars racing out from numbered bursts.

items.name: Funnel
items.description: Stacked slanted slabs dropping into place, each narrower than the last.

items.name: Pictogram
items.description: So many out of a group, as a grid of little suns lighting up.

items.name: Versus
items.description: Two figures head to head on slanted plates with a VS burst.

items.name: Big number
items.description: One huge figure slammed onto a turning burst, with a sticker note.

items.name: Speedometer
items.description: A dashboard dial whose needle swings to the value and trembles.

items.name: Step panels
items.description: A process as illustrated comic panels joined by fat arrows.

items.name: Road timeline
items.description: A coast road with a car driving it and a pin dropping at each milestone.

items.name: Coast map
items.description: An invented coastline with pins dropping on named spots.
